# unifi_dashboard (Data Source)

The `unifi_dashboard` data source retrieves an existing dashboard by name or id.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up an existing dashboard by name.
data "unifi_dashboard" "ops" {
  name = "Operations"
}

output "dashboard_modules" {
  value = data.unifi_dashboard.ops.modules
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `name` (String) The name of the dashboard to look up. Either `name` or `id` must be set.
- `site` (String) The name of the UniFi site where this resource should be applied. If not specified, the default site will be used.

### Read-Only

- `controller_version` (String) The controller version the dashboard was authored against.
- `desc` (String) A free-form description of the dashboard.
- `id` (String) The unique identifier of this resource.
- `is_public` (Boolean) Whether the dashboard is publicly visible.
- `modules` (Attributes List) The modules that make up the dashboard. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--modules))

<a id="nestedatt--modules"></a>
### Nested Schema for `modules`

Read-Only:

- `config` (String) The module configuration payload (opaque JSON string).
- `id` (String) The identifier of the module instance on the dashboard.
- `module_id` (String) The identifier of the module type.
- `restrictions` (String) The module restrictions payload (opaque JSON string).
